user_query: trass gmail with term mgm from last 2 weeks
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.sender_email,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.content_type = 'gmail'
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-14 days')
AND (
  LOWER(g.sender_email) LIKE '%mgm%'
  OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%mgm%'
  OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%mgm%'
  OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%mgm%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000
